headline: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Stock Looks Above Fair Value After Mixed Valuation Checks
summary: Intercontinental Exchange stock has delivered a 37.3% gain over the past five years, yet today the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate sits close to the current market price while traditional valuation multiples lean on the expensive side. That mix leaves Intercontinental Exchange looking closer to fairly priced than clearly cheap or clearly overvalued.
